chunks: The day their faces would be turned on the fire (as on a spit), they will say: 'Alas! If only we had obeyed God, and obeyed the Prophet.'
ai.seo_question: What will disbelievers say when they see the Hellfire?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Ahzab, this verse highlights the ultimate regret of the disbelievers who, while being turned over in the Hellfire, wish they had obeyed Allah and the Prophet. Shia scholars emphasize that this regret comes too late for redemption, serving as a stark warning to believers to maintain steadfastness in following the Prophet's guidance during their earthly life. The phrase 'obeyed the Prophet' is often interpreted in Shia tradition as a reference to the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the concept of Wilayah.
